era: 1452-1519：芬奇镇—佛罗伦萨韦罗基奥工坊—米兰斯福尔扎宫廷—佛罗伦萨—罗马—法国昂布瓦兹
era_en: 1452-1519: Vinci — Verrocchio's workshop, Florence — the Sforza court, Milan — Florence — Rome — Amboise, France
school: 文艺复兴全才（ универсальный homo universalis）；经验科学先驱；解剖学—工程—绘画一体化实践
historical_significance: 文艺复兴精神的化身与近代经验科学的先声。核心方法论：以『经验是一切可靠写作之母』对抗经院权威——凡未经感官与实验检验者不写入结论；以解剖刀打开人体与动物身体的三十余具尸体，把绘画的『真』奠基于骨骼、肌肉与筋膜的真实结构之上；以跨域观察迁移把水的流动、鸟的飞行、头发的卷曲、人的面容当作同一门『运动科学』的不同案例；以类比推理在水的漩涡与空气的湍流之间架设可迁移的模型；以数千页镜文手稿建立自己的问题清单与实验记录体系——飞行器、直升机、降落伞、装甲车、潜水服、机床、运河水利均出自这套笔记工程。他的《维特鲁威人》把人体比例与几何秩序合一，他的《绘画论》把绘画提升为一门以光学、解剖学、透视学为支撑的科学。透视法、明暗法（sfumato）、解剖学插画、水利与机械工程、植物学与地质学的观察记录，共同构成一部尚未分科时代的『通用学问』工程。此后的伽利略式实验科学、现代解剖图谱、工程制图与仿生设计，都能在他的手稿里找到源头。
historical_significance_en: The embodiment of the Renaissance spirit and herald of modern empirical science. Core methodology: against scholastic authority he set 'experience as the mother of all reliable writing'—nothing untested by senses and experiment enters the conclusions; with the dissecting knife he opened more than thirty human and animal bodies, grounding the 'truth' of painting in the real structure of bone, muscle, and sinew; through cross-domain observation he treated the flow of water, the flight of birds, the curl of hair, and the human face as different cases of one 'science of movement'; through analogical reasoning he built transferable models between the vortices of water and the turbulence of air; across thousands of pages of mirror-script notebooks he built a personal system of question lists and experimental records—the flying machine, helicopter, parachute, armored vehicle, diving suit, machine tools, and canal hydraulic works all issued from this notebook engineering. His Vitruvian Man unified human proportion with geometric order; his Treatise on Painting raised painting into a science supported by optics, anatomy, and perspective. Perspective, sfumato, anatomical illustration, hydraulic and mechanical engineering, and observational records in botany and geology together form a 'general learning' project from an age before disciplines. Galilean experimental science, the modern anatomical atlas, engineering drawing, and bionic design all find a source in his notebooks.
unique_thinking: 史上最彻底的『眼与手』的统一者。核心方法论：视觉优先——绘画是比文字更精确的认知工具，图解与文字互为注释，思维在纸面上以图像进行；观察优先于阅读——『读我的人要跟着经验走，而不是跟着词句』，凡书本能给出而经验可检验者，一律交经验裁决；跨域优先于专精——他不承认学科边界，水、鸟、肌肉、机器是同一物理运动的四种呈现；未完成优先于完成——他留下大量未竟之作不是失败而是方法：作品与认知都处于持续修订中，交付的越多意味着被固化的错误越多；好奇优先于答案——他记录的问题清单比解决方案更多，一个问题往往在三十年间被反复重访。他把艺术从技艺改造为研究，把研究改造为可视化工程，是『以图像思考』的百科全书式心智的最高样本。
unique_thinking_en: History's most thorough unifier of eye and hand. Core methodology: vision first—painting is a more precise cognitive instrument than words, diagram and text annotate each other, and thinking proceeds on paper as image; observation over reading—'let whoever reads me follow experience rather than words'; whatever books assert and experience can test is handed to experience for verdict; cross-domain over specialization—he recognizes no disciplinary border, water, birds, muscle, and machine being four presentations of one physical movement; unfinished over finished—that he left so much uncompleted is method, not failure: works and knowledge alike live in continuous revision, and the more delivered, the more error congealed; curiosity over answers—his question lists outnumber his solutions, a single question revisited across thirty years. He rebuilt art from craft into research, and research into visualized engineering—the supreme sample of the encyclopedic mind that thinks in images.
key_works: 《温莎手稿》解剖研究 (Anatomical Manuscripts, Windsor)
《莱斯特手稿》(Codex Leicester, 水与地质研究)
《绘画论》(Trattato della Pittura, 学生据手稿编纂)

modes.domain_zh: 把不同领域的现象当作同一底层运动的不同案例来观察，把在一个领域练出的眼与手迁移到另一个领域
modes.domain_en: Observing phenomena of different fields as different cases of the same underlying movement, transferring the eye and hand trained in one domain to another
modes.definition_zh: 达·芬奇的方法起点是拒绝把世界按行业切割：水涡、鸟群、发卷、旗帜、烟雾、人群在他眼里是同一门『运动科学』的不同样品。手稿中 he draws 水的漩涡并标注『空气的运动与水相同』，画鸟翼时研究机械杆件，画衣褶时研究流体卷曲——每次跨域都是一次模型迁移：在领域 A 中练成的结构洞察被直接拿到领域 B 检验。方法有四步：其一，找共同运动——把两个领域的现象抽象到同一物理过程（湍流、传导、杠杆、生长）；其二，带工具过境——把领域 A 的观察记录格式（草图+文字标注+变量列举）原样带进领域 B；其三，对齐差异——逐项检查 B 中哪些因素 A 没有，标注为迁移的边界条件而非忽略项；其四，回程验证——用 B 的新发现在 A 中重画一次，检验原模型是否需要修订。深意在于：专精化的代价是模型锁死在一个领域内失效，而达·芬奇的跨域不是广度表演，是同一套认知装置在不同材料上的重复运转——真正的迁移单位是『看的方式』而不是结论。
modes.definition_en: Da Vinci's starting move was refusing to slice the world by trade: water vortices, flocks of birds, curls of hair, banners, smoke, crowds were for him different samples of one 'science of movement.' In the notebooks he draws the vortex of water and annotates 'the motion of air is like that of water'; studying bird wings he investigates mechanical members; drawing drapery he studies the coiling of fluids—each crossing of domains is a model transfer: structural insight trained in domain A is taken directly to domain B for testing. The method has four steps. First, find the common movement—abstract the phenomena of two fields to the same physical process (turbulence, conduction, leverage, growth). Second, carry the tools across—bring domain A's observational record format (sketch + textual annotation + variable list) into domain B unchanged. Third, align the differences—item by item check which factors B has that A lacks, registering them as boundary conditions of the transfer rather than ignoring them. Fourth, verify on the return trip—redraw the model in A using B's new findings, testing whether the original model needs revision. The deeper point: specialization's price is a model locked inside one domain; Da Vinci's crossing is not breadth as performance but the repeated running of one cognitive apparatus over different materials—the true unit of transfer is 'a way of seeing,' not conclusions.
modes.source_chapter: 《莱斯特手稿》水流与空气卷曲研究；温莎手稿 RL 19115 等鸟类与飞行研究；《绘画论》论运动与衣褶
modes.key_quote_zh: 水的运动如同头发的卷曲——世界的运动是一门学问，行业只是它的分店。
modes.key_quote_en: The motion of water is like the curl of hair—the world's motion is one learning; trades are only its branches.
process_zh: 抽象共同运动：把待研究的两个领域现象归约到同一物理过程，确认迁移对象是结构而非表象
带工具过境：用领域 A 的记录格式（图解+标注+变量表）直接记录领域 B 的观察，禁止另起格式
标注边界条件：逐项列出 B 独有而 A 没有的因素，作为迁移适用范围的显式条款
回程验证：把 B 中学到的新结构带回 A 重画与重算，修订原模型并把修订记入笔记
process_en: Abstract the common movement: reduce the two domains' phenomena to one physical process, confirming the transfer object is structure, not appearance
Carry the tools across: record domain B's observations directly in domain A's record format (diagram + annotation + variable table); starting a new format is barred
Mark the boundary conditions: list item by item the factors unique to B and absent from A, as explicit clauses on the transfer's scope
Verify on the return trip: carry the new structure learned in B back into A, redraw and recompute, revise the original model, and log the revision
representative_cases_zh: 水的漩涡 → 空气的湍流：他在飞行研究中直接复制水流研究的观察格式，鸟翼周围的气流被画成水中的绕流——空气动力学观察的最早系统记录之一
解剖学 → 绘画：肌肉结构知识直接迁移到嘴角、颈项的刻画，《蒙娜丽莎》的微笑是口轮匝肌分层知识的美学兑现
机械 → 生物学：研究鸟翼的关节与膜结构后反推机械翼的杆件设计——观察与发明在同一张纸上完成
反例警示：迁移有代价——他关于心脏瓣膜的漩涡推断部分正确（现代血流动力学证实）但关于空气重量的类比推断有错；跨域结论必须降格为『待验证假设』并回到实验裁决，否则迁移会生产精致的错误
representative_cases_en: Water vortices to air turbulence: in his flight studies he copied the observational format of his water research wholesale, drawing airflow around a bird's wing as flow around an obstruction in water—among the earliest systematic records of aerodynamic observation

Anatomy to painting: knowledge of muscle structure moved directly into the rendering of lip corners and necks; the smile of the Mona Lisa is the aesthetic cash-out of layered knowledge of the orbicularis oris
Mechanism to biology and back: after studying the joints and membranes of birds' wings he worked backward to the struts of a mechanical wing—observation and invention completed on the same sheet

Cautionary case: transfer has a cost—his vortex inference about cardiac valves was partly right (modern hemodynamics confirms it) while his analogy about the weight of air went wrong; cross-domain conclusions must be downgraded to 'hypotheses pending verification' and returned to experimental verdict, or transfer manufactures exquisite error
modern_applications_zh: 工程师转产品经理、医生转数据科学：迁移的不是技能清单而是记录格式与提问框架，按『共同结构-边界条件-回程验证』三段执行
团队知识管理：跨部门项目要求各方用统一观察模板记录问题，迁移的成本从口口相传降为文档格式
个人学习设计：学新领域时强制带一个已掌握领域的分析工具进场，并写出边界条件清单
AI 模型跨任务评估：把『迁移边界条件』显式化为评估维度，区分『结构可迁移』与『表象相似』
modern_applications_en: Engineer to product manager, physician to data scientist: transfer not a skill checklist but the record format and question frame, run in three stages—common structure, boundary conditions, return verification
Team knowledge management: cross-department projects require all parties to log problems on a unified observation template, converting transfer cost from oral lore to document format
Personal learning design: when entering a new field, force yourself to bring one analytic tool from a mastered field and write out its boundary-condition list
Cross-task evaluation of AI models: make 'transfer boundary conditions' an explicit evaluation axis, separating 'structure that transfers' from 'surface resemblance'

modes.domain_zh: 把复杂对象逐层切开、逐层画出来，让读者能从表层回到深层，也把绘制过程本身变成对结构的分析
modes.domain_en: Cutting the complex object layer by layer and drawing each layer, letting readers move from surface to depth—and turning the act of drawing itself into analysis of structure
modes.definition_zh: 达·芬奇解剖了三十余具人体，并在温莎手稿中确立了近代解剖图谱的基本语法：同一结构以四分之三侧视、正侧视、斜视与解剖层次并置，表层皮肤、浅层肌肉、深层肌肉、骨骼逐页剥开——他写道，这种呈现要像剥洋葱一样让读者亲手经历『揭开的次序』。方法有四步：其一，定义分解轴——选择沿哪个维度切开（时间阶段/空间深度/功能层次），轴选错则分解无效；其二，逐层独立记录——每层单独成图成文，禁止用对下层的想象填充本层的观察缺口；其三，建立层间对照——用同一视角、同一比例绘制相邻层，使读者能逐帧比对；其四，标注不确定性——凡凭记忆或推断补出的部分必须显式标记，与亲手观察者区分。深意在于：绘制不是记录的附属而是分析的引擎——手上画不出的层次就是理解上缺失的层次；同时它预演了现代科学可视化的伦理：图与实物之间必须保持可审计的对应，美化即失真。现代医学图谱、工程爆炸图、用户旅程分层图，都是这一方法的直系后裔。
modes.definition_en: Da Vinci dissected more than thirty human bodies and, in the Windsor manuscripts, fixed the basic grammar of the modern anatomical atlas: the same structure shown in three-quarter, profile, and oblique views alongside its anatomical strata, skin, superficial muscle, deep muscle, and bone peeled apart page by page—presented, as he wrote, so the reader may personally undergo 'the order of unveiling,' like peeling an onion. The method has four steps. First, define the axis of decomposition—choose the dimension along which to cut (temporal stage, spatial depth, functional layer); a wrong axis voids the dissection. Second, record each layer independently—each stratum its own figure and text; gaps in this layer's observation must not be filled by imagination of the next. Third, build cross-layer alignment—adjacent layers drawn at the same viewpoint and scale so readers can compare frame by frame. Fourth, mark uncertainty—anything supplied from memory or inference must be flagged as such, distinguished from what was seen with one's own hands. The deeper point: drawing is not the accessory of record but the engine of analysis—whatever the hand cannot draw is what the understanding lacks; and the method prefigures the ethics of modern scientific visualization: an auditable correspondence between image and object, in which beautification is falsification. The modern medical atlas, the engineering exploded view, and the layered user-journey map are all direct descendants.
modes.source_chapter: 温莎手稿解剖研究 (Windsor RL 19058r, 19071r 等)；《绘画论》论精确观察
modes.key_quote_zh: 绘画是比文字更精确的认知工具——凡是手上画不出的层次，就是理解上还缺少的层次。
modes.key_quote_en: Painting is a more precise instrument of knowledge than words—whatever layer the hand cannot draw is a layer the understanding still lacks.
process_zh: 定义分解轴：确定沿时间/空间/功能哪个维度切开对象，并写出该轴上『完整分解』应包含的全部层
逐层独立记录：每层单独成图成文，观察缺口留空并注明，禁止以下层想象填充
建立层间对照：相邻层用同一视角与比例绘制，逐层可叠合比对，给出『揭开次序』的阅读路径
标注不确定部分：记忆补全、推断整合、师承转述一律显式标记，与亲手观察区分
process_en: Define the axis of decomposition: fix along which dimension—time, space, or function—the object is cut, and write out all strata a complete decomposition on that axis must contain
Record each layer independently: each stratum its own figure and text; observation gaps are left open and marked, never filled with imagination of the layer below
Build cross-layer alignment: draw adjacent layers at the same viewpoint and scale so they can be superposed and compared, giving the reader an 'order of unveiling'
Flag the uncertain parts: memory completion, inferred integration, and secondhand report are all explicitly marked, distinguished from first-hand observation
representative_cases_zh: 温莎手稿的躯干解剖序列：同一躯干从皮肤到脊柱逐层剥开并四向视图并置——近代解剖学插图的语法在他笔下成形
子宫与胎儿研究：剖开的子宫逐层呈现胎位与血管，比当时的解剖学文本更准确——分解呈现直接超越同代文献
《最后的晚餐》的透视结构：建筑透视线全部汇聚于基督头部——分层几何分析转化为构图工程
反例警示：分解可能切断真实——活体中各层同时协作，逐层呈现会诱导『某层单独致病/单独负责』的还原论误读；使用分层法必须配套『层间互动』的说明，否则图解会变成偏见的制造机
representative_cases_en: The torso dissection sequence of the Windsor manuscripts: one trunk peeled from skin to spine, four views side by side—in his hand the grammar of the modern anatomical illustration takes shape

The uterus and fetus studies: the opened womb presenting fetal position and vessels layer by layer, more accurate than the anatomical texts of his day—decomposed exposition directly surpassing contemporary literature
The perspective structure of The Last Supper: all architectural perspective lines converging on Christ's head—layered geometric analysis turned into compositional engineering

Cautionary case: decomposition can sever the real—in the living body all strata cooperate at once, and layer-by-layer exposition invites the reductionist misreading that one layer alone causes or is responsible; the layered method must be paired with an account of inter-layer interaction, or the diagram becomes a machine for manufacturing bias
modern_applications_zh: 技术文档写作：复杂系统文档按『分解轴+逐层独立+对照图』组织，禁止跨层粘贴解释性想象
医疗沟通：向患者分层呈现病情（器官层/功能层/生活影响层），每层单独确认理解
组织诊断：把组织按流程/激励/文化三层切开逐层调研，输出层间冲突对照表
AI 可解释性：模型决策按输入层/表征层/输出层分层可视化，标注每层解释的置信来源
modern_applications_en: Technical writing: organize complex-system documents by decomposition axis + independent per-layer records + comparison figures; explanatory imagination pasted across layers is barred
Medical communication: present a condition to patients in layers (organ, function, life impact), confirming understanding at each layer separately
Organizational diagnosis: cut the organization into process, incentive, and culture strata, surveying each, and deliver a cross-stratum conflict table
AI explainability: visualize model decisions by input, representation, and output strata, marking the provenance of confidence for each layer's explanation

modes.domain_zh: 以经验与实验作为一切知识争论的最高裁决者，凡权威与经验冲突处弃权威而从经验，并要求结论可被重演
modes.domain_en: Taking experience and experiment as supreme arbitress of all knowledge disputes, discarding authority wherever it conflicts with experience, and requiring conclusions to be repeatable
modes.definition_zh: 在亚里士多德权威尚统治大学的时代，达·芬奇在手稿中立下方法论誓言：『我把经验当作一切可靠写作之母』『智慧是经验的女儿』『凡不经过数学与经验检验的，都不算科学』。方法有四步：其一，验前清仓——处理一个问题时先列清书本上的既有断言，逐条标记其证据来源；其二，实验设计——为每个待检验断言设计可操作的检验（他研究梁的强度、杠杆比例、水流冲刷都用可测量的装置）；其三，重演要求——同一检验须在不同条件/不同日子重复，排除偶然；其四，弃权条款——凡经验无法检验的问题（神学、形而上学）明确宣布不进入他的科学账本，不假装能裁决。深意在于：经验裁决不是反理论而是给理论设庭期——任何漂亮的理论都必须出庭受审；同时『弃权条款』诚实划界，防止科学越权宣称它裁决不了的事。这比伽利略的实验宣言早一百年，也预演了现代同行评审的内核：可检验、可重演、可证伪。
modes.definition_en: In an age when the authority of Aristotle still ruled the universities, Da Vinci set a methodological oath in his notebooks: 'I take experience as the mother of all reliable writing,' 'wisdom is the daughter of experience,' and 'whatever does not pass the test of mathematics and experiment does not count as science.' The method has four steps. First, clear the shelves before verification—list the standing assertions from books on the question, marking each one's evidentiary source. Second, design the experiment—for every assertion awaiting test, devise an operational check (his studies of beam strength, lever ratios, and scour of water flow all used measurable apparatus). Third, require repetition—the same check repeated under different conditions, on different days, to exclude accident. Fourth, the abstention clause—questions experience cannot test (theology, metaphysics) are declared out of his scientific ledger; he does not pretend to judge them. The deeper point: experience as arbitress is not anti-theory but sets a court date for theory—however elegant, a theory must appear for trial; and the abstention clause draws an honest boundary, barring science from usurping verdicts it cannot deliver. This precedes Galileo's experimental manifesto by a century and rehearses the core of modern peer review: testable, repeatable, falsifiable.
modes.source_chapter: 《大西洋手稿》与《C手稿》经验与数学论断；《绘画论》序论论经验
modes.key_quote_zh: 读我的人要跟着经验走，而不是跟着词句——经验是一切可靠写作之母。
modes.key_quote_en: Let whoever reads me follow experience rather than words—experience is the mother of all reliable writing.
process_zh: 验前清仓：列出问题涉及的全部既有断言及其来源，标记哪些仅是权威转述
设计检验：为每个断言构造可操作的实验或测量，明确被证伪的标准
重演与变条件：同一检验在不同条件与时间重复，记录全部结果而非只记成功案例
弃权与划界：经验无法裁决的问题显式移出科学账本，不做越权结论
process_en: Clear the shelves: list all standing assertions bearing on the question and their sources, marking which are mere transmitted authority
Design the check: for each assertion construct an operational experiment or measurement, with an explicit falsification standard
Repeat under varied conditions: run the same check under different conditions and times, recording all outcomes, not only successes
Abstain and delimit: questions experience cannot decide are explicitly moved out of the scientific ledger; no overreaching conclusions
representative_cases_zh: 梁承重实验：他在笔记本上用逐级加载的方式测横梁强度并推导比例关系——材料力学的先声实验
水冲刷观测：通过实际河道与模型槽观察水流对河床的侵蚀，反驳纯思辨的水性理论
对权威的公开拒绝：他在解剖笔记中直接指出盖伦的错误（如心脏与血管系统的描述）——『权威说的』在他账本里不是证据类型
反例警示：经验裁决依赖仪器与设计的质量——达·芬奇的部分『实验』（如飞行测试）因缺乏控制变量而无法裁决；现代使用者须把实验设计本身送审，否则经验裁决会退化为经验采信
representative_cases_en: Beam-loading experiments: in his notebooks he tested beam strength by progressive loading and derived proportionality—an early foreshadowing of the mechanics of materials
Scour observations: through actual riverbeds and model channels he watched water erode its bed, refuting purely speculative theories of water's nature
Open rejection of authority: in the anatomical notes he points out Galen's errors directly (as in the description of heart and vessels)—'authority says' is not an evidence type in his ledger

Cautionary case: verdict by experience depends on the quality of instruments and design—some of Da Vinci's 'experiments' (his flight tests, for instance) could not adjudicate for lack of controlled variables; modern users must submit the experimental design itself to review, or verdict by experience degrades into credit by anecdote
modern_applications_zh: 产品决策：任何『行业最佳实践』必须先过自家数据检验，权威案例不算证据类型
科研训练：论文引用区分『实证证据』与『权威断言』，结论段标注每个断言的可重演条件
组织决策审计：重大决策记录预测与实际结果的对照时间表，形成可重演的决策账本
AI 评估：模型能力声明必须附可重演的评测协议，区分基准成绩与真实场景验证
modern_applications_en: Product decisions: every 'industry best practice' must first pass the test of your own data; authoritative case studies are not an evidence type
Research training: in citations distinguish empirical evidence from authoritative assertion; in the conclusions, annotate the repeatability conditions of each claim
Organizational decision audit: record a timetable matching predictions against realized outcomes for major decisions, forming a repeatable decision ledger
AI evaluation: capability claims must ship a reproducible evaluation protocol, separating benchmark scores from real-scenario validation

modes.domain_zh: 把自然当作工程师的最高范本，从生物结构中提取力学与运动原理，再转化为可建造的机械设计
modes.domain_en: Taking nature as the supreme exemplar of the engineer, extracting mechanical and kinetic principles from biological structures and converting them into buildable machine designs
modes.definition_zh: 达·芬奇的发明目录几乎全部由仿生驱动：扑翼机来自鸟翼的关节与膜结构，降落伞来自对下落生物的观察，装甲车与机械来自龟甲与人体的力学组合。他的信条是：自然不浪费、不冗余，每个结构都是被物理约束打磨过的最优解，因此工程师的第一课是读懂自然的设计文档。方法有四步：其一，结构观察——对目标生物做解剖级观察，搞清各部件的材料、连接与运动方式；其二，原理提取——把生物结构抽象为力学/材料学原理（羽膜的柔性、骨骼的中空、肌腱的传力路径）；其三，工程转译——用当时的材料（木、革、绳、铁）实现同等原理，标注材料能力与生物原型的差距；其四，失效分析——思考该结构在自然中如何失效，并让机械设计避开同类失效模式。深意在于：仿生不是外形模仿而是约束继承——自然的设计预算是能量与材料，人类的工程预算也是；真正可迁移的是『在约束下求解的方式』。现代仿生学、翼型设计、机器人关节，都是这一方法的后裔。
modes.definition_en: Da Vinci's catalogue of inventions is almost entirely bionic in origin: the ornithopter from the joints and membranes of birds' wings, the parachute from observation of falling creatures, the armored car and machines from the mechanics of tortoise shell and the human body. His creed: nature wastes nothing and adds nothing—every structure is an optimum polished by physical constraint—so the engineer's first lesson is to read nature's design documents. The method has four steps. First, structural observation—dissection-grade study of the target organism, clarifying each part's material, articulation, and motion. Second, principle extraction—abstract the biological structure into mechanical or material principles (the flexibility of feather membrane, the hollowness of bone, the force path of tendon). Third, engineering translation—realize the same principle in the materials of the day (wood, leather, cord, iron), marking the gap between material capability and biological prototype. Fourth, failure analysis—consider how the structure fails in nature, and steer the machine design away from the same failure modes. The deeper point: bionics is not imitation of form but inheritance of constraint—nature's design budget is energy and material, and the human engineering budget is the same; what truly transfers is 'the way of solving under constraint.' Modern biomimetics, airfoil design, and robotic joints are all descendants of this method.
modes.source_chapter: 《论鸟的飞行》(1505)；《大西洋手稿》机械设计页；温莎手稿动物解剖研究
modes.key_quote_zh: 自然是一切发明的大师——她从不缺失，也从不冗余；工程师的第一课是读懂她的设计文档。
modes.key_quote_en: Nature is the master of all inventions—she never lacks and never redundates; the engineer's first lesson is to read her design documents.
process_zh: 结构观察：对生物原型做解剖级观察，登记材料、连接方式与运动自由度
原理提取：把结构抽象为力学/材料学原理，剥离形状描述保留约束逻辑
工程转译：用可用材料实现同等原理，显式标注材料差距与性能预期
失效分析：研究原型的自然失效模式，让设计避开同类弱点并设计冗余
process_en: Observe the structure: dissection-grade study of the biological prototype, logging material, articulation, and degrees of freedom
Extract the principle: abstract the structure into mechanical or material principles, stripping shape description while keeping the logic of constraint
Translate to engineering: realize the same principle in available materials, marking material gaps and performance expectations explicitly
Analyze failure: study the prototype's natural failure modes and steer the design away from the same weaknesses, adding redundancy
representative_cases_zh: 扑翼机设计：从乌鸦与鸢的飞行观察中提取翼面折叠与拍击节奏，手稿标注翼膜材料的形变要求——仿生观察与机械图纸同页完成
解剖级飞行研究：他为飞行器研究解剖鸟体，理解胸肌与翼骨的传力路径——『先读懂自然文档再写工程文档』的直接样本
装甲龟形战车：壳形防护+内部传动的人机布局——把动物防御结构转译为车辆工程
反例警示：仿生有材料鸿沟——达·芬奇的扑翼机败于人力功率密度远低于鸟类肌肉，失败不在观察而在转译材料；现代仿生设计必须先做『功率/材料预算表』，证明可用材料能兑现提取的原理
representative_cases_en: The ornithopter: from watching crows and kites he extracted wing folding and beat rhythm, annotating the deformation requirements of wing membrane—bionic observation and mechanical drawing completed on one page

Dissection-grade flight research: for his flying machines he dissected birds, understanding the force path from pectoral muscle to wing bone—the direct sample of 'read nature's document before writing the engineering one'
The turtle-shaped armored vehicle: shell protection plus an internal drive layout for men and machines—animal defense structure translated into vehicle engineering

Cautionary case: bionics faces a materials gap—Da Vinci's ornithopter failed because human power density falls far below avian muscle; the failure lay not in observation but in translation materials. Modern bionic design must first produce a 'power/materials budget sheet' proving available materials can cash the extracted principle
modern_applications_zh: 机器人设计：抓取器从章鱼触手/灵长类手指提取传力路径，先写生物原型分析页再写工程页
建筑与结构：高层结构从植物茎秆提取中空与分叉逻辑，附材料预算表
软件架构：把生物冗余（如免疫系统多道防线）转译为系统容错层次设计
个人工具选择：从成熟工具的『使用约束』中提取原理，而非照搬其外形与参数
modern_applications_en: Robotics: extract force paths from octopus tentacles or primate fingers for grippers—the biological-prototype analysis page precedes the engineering page
Architecture and structures: derive hollow-core and branching logic from plant stems for high-rise structures, with a materials budget sheet attached
Software architecture: translate biological redundancy (the immune system's layered defenses) into fault-tolerance tiers
Personal tool selection: extract principles from the usage constraints of mature tools rather than copying their shape and parameters

modes.domain_zh: 用个人化、可长期持有、图文一体的笔记系统承载毕生的观察与实验，使知识积累不依赖外部出版与认可
modes.domain_en: Carrying a lifetime of observation and experiment in a personal, long-held, image-text-integrated notebook system, so accumulation of knowledge depends on neither external publication nor recognition
modes.definition_zh: 达·芬奇留下约七千页手稿，以镜像书写（自右向左反写）记录观察、草图、实验、购物清单与诗草——镜像可能为防涂抹（左手书写）而非纯密码，但它标志着一个决定性的事实：他把『自己的记录系统』当作知识的正本，而不把出版与学院认可当作必要条件。方法有四步：其一，随身携带——笔记必须能随时捕捉，他的手稿含速记符号与专用缩写系统以降低记录摩擦；其二，图文一体——同一页上草图、文字标注、变量列举与问题混合排布，图像是论证的一部分而非插图；其三，不删改旧页——旧观察保留原样，新认识另起页面并交叉引用，形成可追溯的认知演化史；其四，定期重访——同一问题隔年重访并在新页写下差异。深意在于：私有笔记系统的最大价值是摆脱外部评审的时滞与偏见——先诚实地记录，再考虑表达；同时旧页保留使错误也成为资产（可分析当时的推理缺陷）。现代实验室日志、个人知识库（PKM）、obsidian 式链接笔记，都是这一方法的工程化后裔。
modes.definition_en: Da Vinci left some seven thousand pages of manuscripts, in mirror script (right to left) recording observations, sketches, experiments, shopping lists, and drafts of verse—the mirroring perhaps guarding against smudging (he wrote left-handed) rather than pure cipher, but marking a decisive fact: he treated his own record system as the original text of knowledge, with publication and academic recognition as unnecessary conditions. The method has four steps. First, always carried: notes must be capturable at any moment; his manuscripts include shorthand symbols and a private abbreviation system to lower the friction of recording. Second, image-text integration: on one page sketches, annotations, variable lists, and questions interleave; the image is part of the argument, not an illustration of it. Third, old pages never erased: earlier observations stand as written; new understanding starts a fresh page with cross-references, forming a traceable history of cognitive evolution. Fourth, periodic revisit: the same question revisited years apart, differences written on the new page. The deeper point: the great value of a private notebook system is escape from the lag and bias of external review—record honestly first, consider expression later; and preserved old pages make errors into assets (one can analyze the reasoning flaw of the time). The modern laboratory log, personal knowledge management, and Obsidian-style linked notes are all engineered descendants.
modes.source_chapter: 全部手稿体系：《大西洋手稿》《温莎手稿》《阿伦德尔手稿》等约七千页的持续记录实践
modes.key_quote_zh: 我在纸上比在世界上更自由——我的笔记是我的大学，不设学位，只设问题。
modes.key_quote_en: On paper I am freer than in the world—my notebooks are my university, granting no degrees, only questions.
process_zh: 降低记录摩擦：随身系统+速记符号+固定缩写，保证任何观察可在分钟级入册
图文一体排版：每页允许草图、标注、变量表与问题共存，图像作为论证要素而非装饰
旧页冻结新页演进：旧记录不删改，新认识另起页并注明指向旧页，保留推理演化链
定期重访对照：对关键问题设重访节奏，重访页必须回答『上次以来的差异与原因』
process_en: Lower the friction of recording: a carried system plus shorthand symbols and fixed abbreviations, guaranteeing any observation can enter the ledger within minutes
Image-text layout: each page freely mixes sketch, annotation, variable table, and question; images as elements of the argument, not decoration
Freeze old pages, evolve on new ones: old records never altered; new understanding on a new page pointing back to the old, preserving the chain of reasoning
Revisit on schedule: set a revisit cadence for key questions; each revisit page must answer 'what has changed since last time, and why'
representative_cases_zh: 七千页手稿的连续记录：从 1490 年代到临终，同一主题（水、飞行、解剖）在几十年间反复出现并逐次深化——长期私有系统的复利样本
《论鸟的飞行》的形成：飞行主题的散页笔记最终汇成专题册——私有系统的『从积累到专题化』路径
镜像书写的实用主义：多数研究者认为是左手书写防涂抹的副产品——私有系统的个人化不影响其作为正本的效力
反例警示：私有系统有『身后中断』风险——达·芬奇手稿散逸数百年、部分遗失（如《马德里手稿》至 1965 年才重现），私有正本若无交接与出版安排，知识可能随人而逝；记录系统必须配套『遗嘱条款』（继承人/公开/数字化）
representative_cases_en: Seven thousand pages of continuous record: from the 1490s to his death the same themes (water, flight, anatomy) recur across decades, deepening each time—the compound-interest sample of a long-term private system
The making of On the Flight of Birds: loose sheets on flight eventually gathered into a dedicated codex—the private system's path 'from accumulation to thematization'

The pragmatism of mirror script: most scholars read it as the by-product of left-handed writing guarding against smudging—personalization of the private system does not diminish its force as the original text

Cautionary case: private systems risk posthumous interruption—scattered for centuries with parts lost (the Madrid Codices resurfaced only in 1965); a private original without handover and publication arrangements may die with its author. A record system must ship with 'testamentary clauses'—heir, publication, digitization
modern_applications_zh: 个人知识库：图文混排+旧页冻结+交叉引用的笔记纪律，拒绝为美观而重写历史
实验室/工程日志：原始数据页不可修改，修正另起页并注明原因——可审计的科研纪律
团队复盘文化：决策过程留痕而非只留结论，旧判断保留以供认知演化分析
数字遗产规划：私人知识库设继承与公开条款，避免个人系统随账号而亡
modern_applications_en: Personal knowledge base: mixed image-text, frozen old pages, cross-references—a discipline against rewriting history for tidiness
Laboratory and engineering logs: raw data pages immutable; corrections on new pages with reasons—an auditable scientific discipline
Team retrospective culture: keep the decision trail, not only the conclusion; old judgments preserved for analysis of cognitive evolution
Digital-legacy planning: private knowledge bases get heirship and publication clauses, so personal systems do not die with an account

modes.domain_zh: 在两个现象之间搭建结构类比之桥，把已知领域的定律借助对应关系推到未知领域，再以观察检验桥的承载力
modes.domain_en: Building a bridge of structural analogy between two phenomena, carrying laws of the known domain to the unknown via correspondence, then testing the bridge's load-bearing capacity by observation
modes.definition_zh: 达·芬奇是类比推理的大师级使用者：他把水的漩涡与空气的湍流对应，把人体的骨骼肌肉与机械的杠杆绳索对应，把植物的枝干分布与河流的支流分布对应。类比在他手上有明确的工作纪律：其一，同构优先——先证明两个系统在拓扑/几何/力学上同构（漩涡的环形流场 vs 湍流的环形流场），再谈类比；其二，对应表显式化——列出『A 的此项 ↔ B 的此项』的逐项对照，未列入对照表的性质不参与推理；其三，负载检验——类比推出的结论必须回到目标领域做观察验证，桥能载多少结论由观察说了算；其四，边界标注——类比的失效点显式登记（空气可压缩而水不可，故某些水定律不可迁移）。深意在于：类比是最强大的启发式也是最危险的证据——它负责『提出』而非『证明』结论；达·芬奇的时代没有仪器充分检验他的空气-水类比，但他坚持把类比结论写成可检验的断言而非装饰性修辞，这正是科学类比与文学隐喻的分界线。现代跨域创新、模型迁移、从物理系统到机器学习的对应推理，都运行在同样的桥上。
modes.definition_en: Da Vinci is a masterful user of analogical reasoning: he maps water vortices to air turbulence, the body's bones and muscles to a machine's levers and cords, the branching of plants to the tributaries of rivers. Analogy in his hands obeys a clear working discipline. First, isomorphism before analogy—prove the two systems isomorphic in topology, geometry, or mechanics (the annular flow field of a vortex vs. that of turbulence) before reasoning by analogy. Second, make the correspondence table explicit—itemize 'A's this ↔ B's this'; properties not entered in the table take no part in the inference. Third, load testing—conclusions drawn across the bridge must return to the target domain for observational verification; how much the bridge bears is decided by observation. Fourth, mark the boundaries—the analogy's failure points are registered explicitly (air is compressible, water is not; some laws of water will not travel). The deeper point: analogy is the mightiest heuristic and the most dangerous evidence—it proposes conclusions, never proves them; Da Vinci's age lacked instruments to test his air-water bridge fully, but he insisted on writing analogical conclusions as testable assertions rather than decorative rhetoric—the dividing line between scientific analogy and literary metaphor. Modern cross-domain innovation, model transfer, and correspondence reasoning from physical systems to machine learning all run over the same bridge.
modes.source_chapter: 《莱斯特手稿》水与空气对应研究；《论鸟的飞行》；《大西洋手稿》机械与人体对应页
modes.key_quote_zh: 类比是最好的向导，也是最会撒谎的证人——让它引路，别让它作证。
modes.key_quote_en: Analogy is the best of guides and the most perjuring of witnesses—let it lead the way, never let it testify.
process_zh: 验证同构：先证明两系统在结构/力学/拓扑上同构，排除仅是表面相似
编制对应表：逐项列出两域的对应元素与对应量，表外性质不参与推理
推导并负载检验：由类比提出目标域假设，立即设计观察或实验检验其承载力
标注边界：登记类比失效点（哪个对应量在目标域不成立），界定结论适用范围
process_en: Verify isomorphism: first prove the two systems isomorphic in structure, mechanics, or topology, excluding mere surface resemblance
Compile the correspondence table: itemize the paired elements and quantities of the two domains; properties off the table take no part in the inference
Derive and load-test: propose a target-domain hypothesis via the analogy and immediately design observation or experiment to test its bearing
Mark the boundary: register the analogy's failure points—which correspondences fail in the target domain—bounding the scope of conclusions
representative_cases_zh: 水-空气类比的系统运用：他在飞行手稿中写明『空气的运动与水的运动在同类现象下相似』，并逐项对齐密度与流速差异——类比纪律的范本
心脏-漩涡类比：他把主动脉窦内的血流画成漩涡并推断其使瓣膜闭合——该类比在 20 世纪被现代血流动力学证实，是类比负载检验的经典胜例
机械-人体对应：以绳索与杠杆模拟肌腱与关节受力，反过来用人体结构改进机械设计——双向对应表
反例警示：他的部分类比越界失效（如把水的不压缩性带入空气推理）；教训是类比结论必须附『失效条件清单』——无此清单的类比不是推理，是修辞
representative_cases_en: Systematic use of the water-air analogy: in the flight manuscripts he states 'the motion of air resembles the motion of water in like phenomena,' aligning density and velocity differences item by item—the model of analogical discipline

The heart-vortex analogy: he drew the blood flow in the aortic sinuses as vortices inferring that they close the valves—an analogy confirmed by modern hemodynamics in the twentieth century, the classic win of load-tested analogy
Machine-body correspondence: ropes and levers modeling tendon and joint loading, then human structure feeding back into machine design—a bidirectional correspondence table

Cautionary case: some of his analogies overran their bounds (carrying water's incompressibility into air); the lesson is that analogical conclusions must ship with a 'list of failure conditions'—an analogy without such a list is not reasoning but rhetoric
modern_applications_zh: 跨行业产品创新：把其他行业的解法按对应表逐项映射到本行业，先验证同构再上线
科研选题：跨领域阅读时维护『对应表+失效清单』，把灵感立即转为可检验假设
AI 迁移学习评估：类比的结构对应与失效条件显式化为评估维度
组织沟通：用结构类比解释复杂系统时公开对应表，防止听众把隐喻当证据
modern_applications_en: Cross-industry product innovation: map another industry's solution item by item through a correspondence table; verify isomorphism before launch
Research topic selection: maintain 'correspondence tables + failure lists' while reading across fields, converting inspiration instantly into testable hypotheses
Evaluating transfer learning in AI: make structural correspondence and failure conditions explicit evaluation axes
Organizational communication: when explaining complex systems by structural analogy, publish the correspondence table so listeners do not mistake metaphor for evidence

modes.name_en: Quantified Observation of Light, Shadow and Perspective
modes.domain_zh: 把视觉经验拆解为可测量的光学量（透视比例、光强衰减、空气透视），用几何与分级标尺把『看』变成『计算』
modes.domain_en: Decomposing visual experience into measurable optical quantities—perspective proportion, attenuation of light intensity, atmospheric perspective—and turning 'seeing' into 'computing' with geometry and graded scales
modes.definition_zh: 达·芬奇的绘画革命本质上是一场量化革命：他把手稿大量篇幅用于把视觉拆成可计算量——线性透视（远处物体按几何比例缩小）、光强衰减（光按距离平方衰减的观察）、空气透视（远景因空气介质而蓝化模糊）、明暗梯度（球面受光的十级明暗刻度）。方法有四步：其一，参数化感官——把『看起来更远/更暗/更柔』翻译为可测参数（距离、角度、照度层级）；其二，建立标尺——用分级刻度（他的明暗十级表）把连续感受离散化为可操作档位；其三，几何化验证——用透视线、焦点、比例图验证参数化是否自洽；其四，回馈创作——量化结果直接进入作品（sfumato 的十数层半透明釉染是明暗梯度的物化执行）。深意在于：感官经验不是不可分析的神秘物，而是可拆解、可分级、可复核的数据流；一旦视觉被参数化，审美判断就从口味之争变成可教学的工艺。现代摄影曝光理论、计算机图形学渲染方程、色彩管理系统，都走在达·芬奇画出的这条量化轨道上。
modes.definition_en: Da Vinci's pictorial revolution was at bottom a quantitative one: he devoted large tracts of his manuscripts to decomposing vision into computable quantities—linear perspective (distant objects shrinking by geometric proportion), attenuation of light (his observation of decay with distance), atmospheric perspective (far views blued and blurred by the medium of air), and gradations of light and shadow (a ten-step scale of illumination on the sphere). The method has four steps. First, parameterize the senses—translate 'looks farther/darker/softer' into measurable parameters (distance, angle, tiers of illumination). Second, build scales—graded scales (his ten-step light-dark table) discretize continuous feeling into workable tiers. Third, verify geometrically—perspective lines, focal points, and proportion diagrams check whether the parameterization is self-consistent. Fourth, feed back into creation—quantified results enter the work directly (the dozen-plus translucent glazes of sfumato being the physical execution of the light-dark gradient). The deeper point: sense experience is not an unanalyzable mystery but a decomposable, gradable, checkable data stream; once vision is parameterized, aesthetic judgment passes from a war of tastes into a teachable craft. Modern exposure theory in photography, the rendering equation of computer graphics, and color-management systems all run along the quantitative track Da Vinci laid out.
modes.source_chapter: 《绘画论》透视与明暗章节；《大西洋手稿》光学笔记；温莎手稿光影研究
modes.key_quote_zh: 把『看起来更远』翻译成数字——美感一旦被参数化，就从口角变成工艺。
modes.key_quote_en: Translate 'it looks farther' into numbers—once beauty is parameterized, quarrel turns into craft.
process_zh: 参数化感官：把目标领域的定性感受逐个翻译为可测量参数，建立参数清单
建立分级标尺：用离散档位覆盖连续变化，标尺档数按工艺可执行性设定
几何/逻辑验证：检查参数间是否自洽（透视比例与明暗梯度互不矛盾），修正冲突参数
执行与回馈：把参数直接落入作品/产品，用成品反馈修订标尺与参数定义
process_en: Parameterize the senses: translate the domain's qualitative feelings into measurable parameters one by one, building a parameter list
Build graded scales: cover continuous variation with discrete tiers, the tier count set by what the craft can execute
Verify geometrically/logically: check the parameters for self-consistency (perspective proportions must not contradict light-dark gradients) and correct conflicts
Execute and feed back: land the parameters directly in the work or product; revise scales and parameter definitions from the finished result
representative_cases_zh: 《最后的晚餐》与《岩间圣母》：透视灭点与空气透视（远山蓝化）的教科书级应用——量化观察直接成就艺术史名作
sfumato 技法：明暗十级梯度以十数层透明釉染逐层兑现，《蒙娜丽莎》轮廓的『不可捉摸』实为分级光学的精确执行
十级明暗刻度：他在手稿中为球面受光建立离散刻度——感官量化的工具化样本
反例警示：量化会漏掉无法参数化的维度——达·芬奇的光学量化精确，但他同样警告『画家不可被刻度奴役』；现代使用者须保留『标尺之外的判断』通道，防止标尺本身成为新的教条
representative_cases_en: The Last Supper and the Virgin of the Rocks: textbook application of the vanishing point and atmospheric perspective (the bluing of distant mountains)—quantified observation directly producing masterworks
The sfumato technique: the ten-step light-dark gradient cashed out in a dozen translucent glaze layers; the Mona Lisa's 'elusiveness of contour' is the precise execution of graded optics
The ten-step scale of light and shadow: in his manuscripts he builds a discrete scale for the illumination of the sphere—the instrumental sample of quantifying the senses

Cautionary case: quantification omits what cannot be parameterized—Da Vinci's optical quantification was exact, yet he likewise warned that 'the painter must not be enslaved by the scale'; modern users must keep a channel for 'judgment beyond the scale,' lest the scale itself become a new dogma
modern_applications_zh: 摄影与影视：曝光、色温、景深参数化为可复核量表，审美争论转为参数讨论
UI/UX 设计：建立设计 token 体系（间距/字级/色阶的分级标尺），把『感觉不协调』转为档位修正
产品评审：把『体验好/差』拆为可分级维度逐项打分，量化回馈迭代
数据可视化：感知量化（色彩对比度、视觉重量分级）直接进入图表设计规范
modern_applications_en: Photography and film: exposure, color temperature, depth of field parameterized into checkable scales; aesthetic disputes become parameter discussions
UI/UX design: a design-token system (graded scales of spacing, type size, color steps) turns 'feels off' into tier corrections
Product review: split 'good/bad experience' into gradable dimensions scored item by item, quantifying feedback for iteration
Data visualization: perceptual quantification (contrast ratios, visual-weight tiers) enters chart-design standards directly

modes.domain_zh: 把好奇心制度化为可持续的问题清单与重访机制，让问题的积累与深化先于答案，并以数十年为周期重访老问题
modes.domain_en: Institutionalizing curiosity as a sustainable question list and revisit mechanism, letting the accumulation and deepening of questions precede answers, and revisiting old questions on cycles of decades
modes.definition_zh: 达·芬奇手稿中最动人的部分不是答案而是问题：他记录『啄木鸟用什么舌头』『鳄的下颚如何工作』『为何鱼在水中比海中物体的影子快』——有的问题三十年间被反复重访。他展示了好奇心的工程化：好奇不是气质而是可运营的系统。方法有四步：其一，随手捕获——任何触发疑问的瞬间立即入册，问题与答案同权重记录（他的手稿中问题清单远多于答案）；其二，问题分级——按『可观察验证/需仪器/纯思辨』分类，避免把不可答的问题误当待办；其三，定期重访——为重要问题设重访节奏，重访时先答『上次以来我多知道了什么』；其四，允许悬置——问题可长期挂起而不焦虑，达·芬奇的许多问题终生未答，但挂起不等于放弃。深意在于：以问题为中心的知识积累天然抗过时——答案会过期，好问题不会；同时问题清单是个人的『认知资产负债表』：清单长度反映视野，重访深度反映功力。现代研究日志、个人 OKR 中的学习项、T 型知识树的开放分支，都是这一方法的后裔。
modes.definition_en: The most moving parts of Da Vinci's manuscripts are not answers but questions: he logs 'what tongue does the woodpecker use,' 'how does the jaw of the crocodile work,' 'why does the shadow of a fish in water move faster than the object'—some revisited across thirty years. He shows curiosity engineered: not a temperament but an operable system. The method has four steps. First, capture on the spot: any instant that triggers wonder enters the ledger at once; questions are recorded with the same weight as answers (his question lists outnumber his answers). Second, grade the questions—by 'observable / needs instruments / purely speculative'—lest the unanswerable be mistaken for a to-do. Third, revisit on schedule: important questions get a revisit cadence, each revisit first answering 'what do I know now that I did not.' Fourth, allow suspension: questions may hang for years without anxiety; many of Da Vinci's went unanswered for life, but suspension is not abandonment. The deeper point: knowledge accumulation centered on questions is naturally future-proof—answers expire, good questions do not; and the question list is one's cognitive balance sheet: its length reflects the breadth of one's vision, the depth of one's revisits the depth of one's craft. Modern research logs, the learning items of personal OKRs, and the open branches of a T-shaped knowledge tree are all descendants.
modes.source_chapter: 手稿问题清单（如《B手稿》《大西洋手稿》各页散布的疑问记录）；温莎手稿动物学疑问
modes.key_quote_zh: 答案会过期，好问题不会——我的一生都在为尚未提出的问题做准备。
modes.key_quote_en: Answers expire; good questions do not—all my life I have been preparing for questions not yet asked.
process_zh: 即时捕获：建立随身问题登记通道，问题与答案同权重入册
问题分级：按可验证性/所需资源/时间尺度分类，识别『终生问题』与『本周问题』
重访机制：为长期问题设重访日历，每次重访必写『增量认知』
悬置管理：明确标记挂起状态与重启触发条件，防止问题无声死亡
process_en: Capture at once: a carried channel for logging questions; questions enter the ledger with the same weight as answers
Grade the questions: classify by verifiability, required resources, and time scale, distinguishing 'lifetime questions' from 'this week's questions'
The revisit mechanism: a revisit calendar for long-term questions; every revisit must state the 'increment of knowing'
Suspension management: mark suspended status and restart triggers explicitly, so questions do not die silently
representative_cases_zh: 啄木鸟舌头之问：这个问题在手稿中被记录并几十年后重访——终生问题清单的真实样本
水流疑问驱动《莱斯特手稿》：对水的一系列疑问最终形成专题研究——问题清单的『从积累到专题化』路径
问题先于答案的公开姿态：他在解剖笔记中大量只写问题不写结论——以问题而非答案建立学术信誉
反例警示：问题清单会膨胀失控——达·芬奇大量项目烂尾与问题过载直接相关；现代使用者须设『在制问题数上限』，新问题入册须淘汰或冻结一条旧问题，否则清单会从资产变成焦虑源
representative_cases_en: The question of the woodpecker's tongue: recorded and revisited decades later in the manuscripts—the true sample of a lifetime question list
Questions of water driving the Codex Leicester: a series of questions about water finally congealed into a dedicated study—the question list's path 'from accumulation to thematization'
The public posture of questions before answers: across the anatomical notes he writes many questions without conclusions—building scholarly credit on questions rather than answers

Cautionary case: question lists bloat out of control—many of Da Vinci's abandoned projects connect directly to question overload; modern users must set a cap on 'questions in progress,' and every new entry must retire or freeze an old one, lest the list turn from asset into anxiety
modern_applications_zh: 个人学习系统：维护问题清单而非书单，按重访节奏管理长期疑问
团队创新机制：『问题墙』制度——开放问题公开挂起，任何人可认领与重访
研究选题：用『终生问题/本周问题』分级分配精力，防止被短期热点全部占满
AI 辅助研究：把个人问题清单作为 AI 检索的种子，定期由 AI 通报相关领域进展
modern_applications_en: Personal learning systems: maintain a question list rather than a book list, managing long-term questions on a revisit cadence
Team innovation mechanisms: a 'question wall' institution—open problems publicly suspended, claimable and revisitable by anyone
Research topic selection: allocate energy by 'lifetime vs. this week' question grading, keeping short-term trends from crowding out everything
AI-assisted research: seed AI retrieval with one's personal question list, with the AI periodically reporting progress in the relevant fields

modes.domain_zh: 把『未完成』作为知识生产的方法而非缺陷：作品长期处于修订中，认知每更新一步就回改一步，拒绝为交付而冻结错误
modes.domain_en: Treating 'the unfinished' as a method of knowledge production rather than a defect: works live in long revision, each step of new knowledge pulling a step of rework, refusing to freeze error for the sake of delivery
modes.definition_zh: 达·芬奇传世完成的画作屈指可数，而未完成品却构成方法论：《博士来拜》长期停笔因透视与解剖的重新计算，《蒙娜丽莎》带在身边修订十余年直至临终——他宁可不交货也不固化已知的错误。方法有四步：其一，修订触发显式化——列出『什么新知识出现就必须回改什么』的映射（新解剖认知→重画相应部位）；其二，分层冻结——作品的某些部分允许定稿（底层构图），另一些保持可改（受新知识影响层）；其三，交付替代方案——无法完成时不弃置而是『移交给他人可继续的状态』（他的《绘画论》即由学生从未完成手稿编纂而成）；其四，修订账本——每次回改记录触发原因，使未完成史成为认知演化史。深意在于：完成与正确的张力中他选择正确——但这一选择的代价（大量烂尾与违约）也必须诚实入账：未完成法要求生活与合同的结构支持，否则就是逃避。现代版本的持续交付、论文修订轮、开源项目的『永不发布 1.0』哲学，都分享了这一方法论的两面。
modes.definition_en: Da Vinci's finished paintings can be counted on one hand, yet the unfinished ones constitute a methodology: the Adoration of the Magi stalled as perspective and anatomy were recomputed; the Mona Lisa went with him for more than a decade of revision until his death—he would rather not deliver than congeal known error. The method has four steps. First, make revision triggers explicit—list the mapping 'when such-and-such new knowledge appears, such-and-such must be reworked' (new anatomical knowledge to the redrawing of the relevant parts). Second, freeze in layers—certain parts of the work may be finalized (the underlying composition) while others stay revisable (layers affected by new knowledge). Third, alternatives to delivery—what cannot be finished is not abandoned but moved to 'a state others can continue' (his Treatise on Painting was compiled by pupils from unfinished manuscripts). Fourth, a revision ledger—each rework records its trigger, so the history of incompleteness becomes the history of cognitive evolution. The deeper point: in the tension between finished and correct he chose correct—but the price of that choice (abundant abandoned projects and breached contracts) must also be honestly booked: the unfinished method demands structural support in one's life and contracts, or it becomes evasion. Modern continuous delivery, journal revision rounds, and the open-source philosophy of 'never shipping 1.0' all share both faces of this methodology.
modes.source_chapter: 《博士来拜》(1481, 未完成) 与《蒙娜丽莎》(约1503-1519) 的修订实践；温莎手稿重画记录；《绘画论》由梅尔齐编纂
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不是不完成，是不肯把已知的错误交付出去——完成是一天的事，正确是一生的事。
modes.key_quote_en: It is not that I fail to finish; I refuse to deliver a known error—finishing is a day's work, correctness a life's.
process_zh: 显式化修订触发：列出『新知识类型→必须回改的部分』映射表，新知到来即触发而非等交付期
分层冻结：区分定稿层与可改层，定稿层只在被证伪时重开
设计移交状态：无法完成时整理为他人可续的状态（索引/注释/半成品规范）
记账修订史：每次回改记录触发知识与改动范围，使未完成成为可分析的过程
process_en: Make revision triggers explicit: a mapping table 'type of new knowledge to parts that must be reworked,' triggered by the arrival of knowledge, not the delivery date
Freeze in layers: distinguish finalized strata from revisable ones; finalized strata reopen only upon falsification
Design the handover state: what cannot be finished is organized into a state others can continue (index, annotations, half-built specifications)
Keep a revision ledger: each rework records the triggering knowledge and scope of change, making the unfinished an analyzable process
representative_cases_zh: 《博士来拜》：透视方案重算导致长期停笔——为正确牺牲交付期的原始样本
《蒙娜丽莎》的十余年修订：颜料层分析显示多轮釉染叠加——未完成法的成品端证据
《绘画论》的身后编纂：学生梅尔齐从遗留手稿辑成——『移交状态』设计的成功案例
反例警示：未完成法有真实的合约与信任成本——他多次因未按期交付失去委托（如威尼斯与教廷的委托纠纷）；使用此法必须前置设计合同结构（分期交付/部分冻结），否则方法会变成对合作者的系统性违约
representative_cases_en: The Adoration of the Magi: recomputation of the perspective scheme caused a long stall—the original sample of correctness at the price of the delivery date
A decade-plus of revision on the Mona Lisa: paint-layer analysis shows multiple rounds of glazing—evidence at the finished-work end of the unfinished method
The posthumous compilation of the Treatise on Painting: his pupil Melzi gathered it from the manuscripts left behind—the successful case of the 'handover state' design

Cautionary case: the unfinished method carries real costs in contracts and trust—he repeatedly lost commissions for non-delivery (disputes at Venice and with the Papacy); users of this method must design contract structure up front (staged delivery, partial freezing), or the method becomes systematic breach toward collaborators
modern_applications_zh: 知识产品运营：内容发布后持续修订并公开版本史，拒绝『一次定稿』
工程交付：区分『可冻结模块』与『受外部知识影响的模块』，交付计划分层
合同与承诺设计：对长期项目预置修订条款与移交条款，对冲未完成风险
个人作品集：公开未完成项目并附修订触发说明，把『烂尾』转译为『进行中』
modern_applications_en: Operating knowledge products: continuous revision after release with a public version history, refusing 'one-shot finality'
Engineering delivery: distinguish freezable modules from modules exposed to external knowledge, layering the delivery plan
Contract and commitment design: preset revision and handover clauses for long projects, hedging the risk of the unfinished
Personal portfolios: publish unfinished projects with stated revision triggers, translating 'abandoned' into 'in progress'

modes.domain_zh: 把审美交付与工程交付当作同一项目的两个面，用统一的底层数据（几何、光学、解剖、材料）同时支撑画作与机械，拒绝在艺术与工程之间切换人格
modes.domain_en: Treating aesthetic delivery and engineering delivery as two faces of one project, supported by the same underlying data—geometry, optics, anatomy, materials—and refusing to switch personalities between art and engineering
modes.definition_zh: 达·芬奇的职业身份表（画家/军事工程师/水利工程师/解剖学家/舞台设计师）不是多才多艺的清单，而是同一套底层能力的多个出口：透视法同时服务《最后的晚餐》与军事测绘，解剖学同时服务肖像与外科认知，水的力学同时服务运河设计与水的绘画。方法有四步：其一，识别共同底座——把各项目依赖的知识拆到最底层（几何/光学/力学/材料），确认它们共享同一套数据；其二，统一记录格式——工程图纸与绘画草图共用同一笔记本体系与标注语言，使知识在两个方向自由流动；其三，交叉注入——用工程的精度纪律提升艺术（透视网格、明暗刻度），用艺术的观察敏感度提升工程（对水流的审美直觉成为设计直觉）；其四，一体交付——最终交付物同时携带两个层面的价值（一幅画也是一份光学论文，一台机器也是一份解剖学陈述）。深意在于：艺术与工程的分裂是分科时代的制度产物而非认知必然——当底层数据统一时，『美』与『对』是同一物理真实在两种交付形式下的呈现。现代 STEAM 教育、设计工程学科、计算美学，都在重建他未曾失去的统一。
modes.definition_en: Da Vinci's professional roster—painter, military engineer, hydraulic engineer, anatomist, stage designer—is not a list of talents but multiple outlets of one underlying competence: perspective serves both The Last Supper and military surveying, anatomy serves both portraiture and surgical understanding, the mechanics of water serves both canal design and the painting of water. The method has four steps. First, identify the common substrate—strip each project's dependencies down to their base stratum (geometry, optics, mechanics, materials), confirming they share one set of data. Second, a unified record format—engineering drawings and painting sketches share one notebook system and annotation language, so knowledge flows freely in both directions. Third, cross-injection—engineering's discipline of precision lifts the art (perspective grids, light-dark scales), while the artist's sensitivity of observation lifts the engineering (an aesthetic intuition for flowing water becoming a design intuition). Fourth, integrated delivery—the final deliverable carries value at both levels at once (a painting is also an optics paper; a machine is also an anatomical statement). The deeper point: the split between art and engineering is an institutional product of the age of disciplines, not a cognitive necessity—when the underlying data is unified, 'the beautiful' and 'the true' are one physical reality in two forms of delivery. Modern STEAM education, the discipline of design engineering, and computational aesthetics are all rebuilding the unity he never lost.
modes.source_chapter: 《绘画论》论绘画为科学；《大西洋手稿》军事与水利工程页；温莎手稿解剖与艺术互证
modes.key_quote_zh: 绘画是一门科学——它的法庭是眼睛，它的数学是透视，它的解剖是真理：美与对，本是同一份图纸。
modes.key_quote_en: Painting is a science—its court is the eye, its mathematics perspective, its anatomy truth: the beautiful and the true are one and the same drawing.
process_zh: 识别共同底座：把项目的知识依赖拆到几何/光学/力学/材料的最底层，确认可共享
统一记录格式：不同交付线的笔记、术语与图纸语言统一，降低跨线迁移成本
交叉注入：把工程精度纪律引入审美工作，把审美观察敏感度引入工程工作
一体交付：让每个交付物同时承载工程正确性与审美价值，而非二选一
process_en: Identify the common substrate: strip each project's knowledge dependencies to the base stratum of geometry, optics, mechanics, materials, confirming shareability
Unify the record format: one notebook system, terminology, and drawing language across delivery lines, cutting the cost of cross-line transfer
Cross-inject: bring engineering's discipline of precision into aesthetic work and the artist's observational sensitivity into engineering work
Integrated delivery: let every deliverable carry both engineering correctness and aesthetic value, rather than choosing one
representative_cases_zh: 《维特鲁威人》：人体比例的几何图解同时是艺术图像与测量学陈述——一体交付的符号级样本
《最后的晚餐》的透视工程：灭点设计与叙事构图在同一次几何计算中完成
米兰水利工程与水的绘画：运河设计的水流知识直接进入《莱达与天鹅》背景的水纹描绘
反例警示：一体交付对雇主构成解释成本——达·芬奇的雇主常只想要『画作』或『战争机器』之一，导致他被视为不可预测的承包人；现代使用者须为综合交付设计『分面验收』（审美面与工程面分别约定验收标准），而非强迫雇主理解全部
representative_cases_en: The Vitruvian Man: a geometric exposition of human proportion that is at once artistic image and metrological statement—the symbolic sample of integrated delivery
The perspective engineering of The Last Supper: vanishing-point design and narrative composition completed in one act of geometric computation
Milan's hydraulic works and the painting of water: knowledge of flow from canal design passing directly into the water patterns of the backgrounds of Leda and the Swan

Cautionary case: integrated delivery imposes an interpretation cost on employers—who often wanted only the 'painting' or the 'war machine'—making him look an unpredictable contractor; modern users must design 'facet acceptance' for integrated delivery (aesthetic and engineering acceptance agreed separately) rather than forcing the client to grasp the whole
modern_applications_zh: 设计工程师角色：同时持有审美判断与技术规范的组织岗位，输出物双面验收
科技产品发布：把技术白皮书与体验叙事作为同一份交付的两个视图
STEAM 教学：课程设计以共同底座（几何/光学/材料）串联艺术与工程任务
个人职业设计：识别自己各方向技能的共同底座，把『多栖』重构为『一底座多出口』
modern_applications_en: The design-engineer role: an organizational post holding aesthetic judgment and technical specification at once, with deliverables accepted on both faces
Technology product launches: the technical whitepaper and the experience narrative as two views of one deliverable
STEAM teaching: curricula threading art and engineering tasks through the common substrate (geometry, optics, materials)
Personal career design: identify the common substrate of one's several skill directions, restructuring 'multi-hyphenate' as 'one substrate, many outlets'
